sentence_1_it: Mentre entrava in prigione il tipo nuovo ebbe un infarto.
sentence_1_en: While entering the prison the new guy suffered a heart attack.
sentence_2_it: Ho sempre pensato che un infarto fosse il modo in cui la natura ti dicesse di morire.
sentence_2_en: I always thought that having a heart attack was the way nature told you to die.
sentence_3_en: I very nearly had a heart attack and died.
